notes.title: Base Raid Alpha 1.2.0 - New game mode, christmas update, language support!
notes.notes:
Base Raid Alpha 1.2.0 is now available to everyone.

It's the biggest update yet since Base Raid's Early Access launch on Steam with lots of new things to take a look at.


New game mode - Mirror

In the new game mode called "Mirror" the enemy surrounds your base and you use the same base you can build in the base editor but it has been mirrored in the middle of the battlefield.

When you move your turrets on one side, the turrets on the other side will mirror the movement and you'll have to stay aware of the enemy on both sides.


Christmas update

We've added some christmas themed stuff into the game. Go check it out yourself, we don't want to spoil it.


Language support

The game is now available in Finnish language and we are working on support for more languages to be added soon. 

To change your language, in your Steam library go to Base Raid's properties and choose your preferred language from the dropdown in the "Language" tab.


Bug fixes!

Base Raid is an Early Access game, which means it is normal to find bugs every now and then. We just fixed dozens of them and to make sure everyone gets the best gameplay experience we keep fixing the issues we encounter.


Merry christmas and happy new year!
